verdict.rationale: Cactus is an on-device inference runtime, so compatibility between runtime versions and downloaded quantized model files is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack has no compatibility policy, format-versioning statement or migration guidance for existing model files across runtime upgrades. The `generation=2` option for keeping Needle 2 deployments running is about choosing a model generation, not about file-format compatibility, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I know whether upgrading the runtime can break compatibility with previously downloaded quantized model files
